title: The New Life Modpack

body:

# The The New Life Modpack
The The New Life Modpack is crafted to enhance the Minecraft experience, particularly for players on the The New Life SMP server, while remaining fully compatible with other vanilla servers. This pack is designed to boost performance, integrate proximity voice chat via Simple Voice Chat for immersive multiplayer interactions, and ensure seamless gameplay compatibility with the The New Life server.

**Here are some of the key mods included:**

- Sodium & Krypton – Improve rendering performance and optimize network communication.
- Iris – Adds shader support.
- Simple Voice Chat – Enables proximity voice communication with other players on the server.
- Bobby – Increases your visible render distance beyond the server's view distance by caching previously loaded chunks.
- Dynamic FPS – Reduces resource usage while Minecraft is running in the background.
- LambDynamicLights – Allows held items and other light sources to illuminate the world dynamically.
- Zoomify – Provide zoom functionality.
- AppleSkin – Displays useful hunger and saturation information directly in-game.
- Mouse Tweaks & Inventory Essentials – Improve inventory management and make item movement more intuitive.
- Chat Heads & More Chat History – Enhance chat with player avatars and an expanded message history.
- Gamma Utils – Provides brightness controls beyond vanilla settings.
- Smooth Scrolling Refurbished – Makes menu and interface scrolling smoother and more natural.
- Cubes Without Borders – Improves the windowed gameplay experience, especially on multi-monitor setups.
- Resourcify – Allows you to browse and install resource packs directly from within Minecraft.
